positive.prompt: Break this spec into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria
Turn the PRD into an ordered task list we can execute
Plan the work into implementable chunks before we start coding

negative.prompt: Encode the output so it is safe against XSS

evals.prompt: Break the attached notifications spec into an executable plan.
evals.expected_output: A static story plan at a path agreed with the user, with an ordered task index and one static worker brief per task; native todo is the main session's only mutable progress list
expectations: Every task has concrete, testable acceptance criteria
Tasks are ordered by explicit dependencies and implementation risk
Tasks are vertical slices rather than horizontal layers
No implementation code is written during planning

The static plan and each worker brief are handed off by path and include acceptance criteria, dependencies, exact owned paths, and focused verification; the main session explicitly owns ordering and shared-file assignment
Mutable progress is represented only in the current main session's native todo/task state, not in Markdown task-status notes, a project JSON store, or a duplicate board
No project-wide claim, lock, automatic DAG readiness, or cross-session ownership guarantee is claimed
